Brampton Plan Schedule 8 District Energy Areas - Lines

District Energy Area Lines identify existing or planned district energy distribution corridors that connect energy generation facilities with surrounding buildings and development areas. These corridors support the efficient delivery of heating and cooling services as part of an integrated energy system.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
